plan.goal: Bounded real-Windows JPEG EXIF/ICC metadata and pixel differential under DC-MP-IMG2, without product colour policy or decoder adoption.

tasks.goal: Measure EXIF1/3/6/8 and valid/invalid/truncated ICC recognition, independent orientation raster relations and decoder differentials.

inputs.description: Tern W10 directive: docs/development/evidence-published/w10-latest/tern-directive.txt; W9 limited completion does not satisfy full IMG2 or IMG3.
DC-MP-IMG2, Product/Design Canon, ADR0009/0012/0013, TESTING and storage-bounded build rules. Existing W5/W8 helpers reused unchanged.

constraints.text: Keep W1-W9 accepted source and evidence unchanged. W10-specific PowerShell GDI+ probe; no crates/media, Runtime, dependency, unsafe, product policy, push or release.
12 fixed 256x192 baseline JPEG sources, 29 serial legs, 45s worker/300s batch, bounded file spools/output/report and terminate/reap on failure. Fresh owned work and exclusive outputs.

Parse actual APP1/APP2/IFD0/ICC tag table from bounded bytes independently. Preserve malformed acceptance as unverified. Retain PNG bytes, recompute RGBA/digests and independently rotate decoded untransformed rasters; no absolute JPEG correctness. ICC colour conversion stays NOT_MEASURED.

New pinned Native source and complete candidate; five independent Gates with identical output declarations, raw status/inspect/verify and artifact hashes; exact authorized successful workspace disposal; Tern PASS0/0/0 then docs-only disposition.

outputs.description: W10 fixtures, bounded independent metadata parser, pixel verifier, Windows matrix and semantic tests.
Two pinned real-Windows runs, encoded/output bytes, metadata interpretation, every-pixel differential and orientation relations with unmeasured boundaries.
Quality/regression logs, five immutable Gate receipts, byte correspondence, exact disposal, Tern review and limited disposition.

acceptance.statement: Independent bytes prove orientation1/3/6/8, valid ICC and invalid/truncated EXIF/ICC; no self-report oracle.
Real WIC/GDI+ decode results include dimensions, canonical pixel digests and case/metadata interpretations; independent control/rotation relations are recomputed from retained outputs.
Failure paths are bounded, terminate/reap, publish no stale success and never promote malformed metadata or mere decoder agreement into content verification.
Source/Gate/Native file hashes agree; all five new Gates pass and full Tern independent review reaches0/0/0 without transferring W9 approval to full IMG2/IMG3.

evaluation.requirement: Real Windows execution twice; independently parsed fixtures, RGBA reconstruction, coordinate rotations and negative mutations through the real verifier.
Taskern prepare, complete local quality/regressions, five pinned independent Gates, immutable receipts, disposal integrity and Tern clean verdict.
